title: The Pretend Train
learning_objectives: Retell how Mo joins the pretend train ride.
Identify Sam wanting to hear waves and Mo wanting to sing with Sam.

parent_prompts: Before reading: Sam makes a train from chairs. Where could this pretend train go?
After page 3: Mo wants to sing with Sam. How could Sam include Mo in the train game?
After reading: Why does Sam stop before they go to the sea together?

quiz.prompt: Why does Mo want to join Sam?
quiz.explanation: Page 3 says Mo wants to sing with Sam. The words tell us his wish; the picture does not show what he wants to do.

quiz.prompt: What do Sam and Mo want to do?
quiz.explanation: Page 2 says Sam wants to hear the waves. Page 3 says Mo wants to sing with Sam. We need both pages to know both wishes, which the pictures do not show.

quiz.prompt: Tell how Mo gets a ride on the pretend train.
quiz.rubric: not yet: names Sam or the train without telling how Mo joins; with support: says Mo wants to sing with Sam and Sam stops, with prompting; independent: explains that Mo wants to sing with Sam, Sam stops, Mo sits down, and they go to the sea together.
quiz.explanation: A retell connects Mo wanting to sing with Sam, Sam stopping, and their shared ride.

activities.prompt: Put Mo joining the train ride in order.

items.text: Mo wants to sing with Sam.
They ride to the sea together.

prompts: What could Sam say to welcome Mo onto the pretend train?
If the train stops again, where could Sam and Mo pretend to go next?

off_screen_prompt: Sit beside a grown-up and pretend to ride to the sea. Take turns stopping the train to welcome each other.
